title: Review #378: two adversarial penny-precision failures
public_pr_body:
Independent docs/tests-only review of public #378 at ccd74ea513307c5584a11f7cd368f38b742ce769. No changes to its branch or feature.

34 passed, 2 failed, 0 skipped: all 32 original calculation cases pass, two independent source checks pass, two new penny assertions fail. Unsafe intermediate revenue aggregation returns a complete profit 1p low; microsecond timestamps accumulating to half a penny also return 1p low. Failures and original setup logs retained. Final TypeScript and targeted ESLint pass.

Source/default and legacy-calculator checks support disabled-by-default and unchanged old maths. Overlap, missing costs, credit and allocation cases pass within tested inputs. Migration 148 has a separate number from 147; combined migration execution, database permissions, browser regression and production operation are explicitly NOT EXECUTED in this review. No database/SQL, private files, real records, merge, candidate edits or John messages. Review done: 2 defects, fixes pending.
